_comment: Direct Ollama Cloud on its OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions wire. Reasoning controls go only to Models the catalog marks as reasoning; the effort vocabulary is none|low|medium|high|max (vBot xhigh is spelled max) and off is the explicit 'none' effort even for on/off thinkers. Readable reasoning replays as text in the Model's own response field; the reviewed Cloud Models answer and replay in reasoning (audited 2026-09-02). Replay scope is full_history except where live replay audits showed a Model ignores earlier Reasoning across Runs (current_run) or always (none). Bodies above 16 MiB are rejected (verified 2026-09-11).

rules.note: These Cloud Models answer with readable reasoning and replay it there, whatever field the upstream catalog names.
Earlier Reasoning is consumed only within the same Run on this gateway.
Earlier Reasoning is ignored on this gateway, so it is not replayed.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash carries JPEG, PNG and WebP images only.
